meta.title: Upload Attachments: Saving the attachment window without providing any file or URL shows validation error or preserves state
gaps: The exact validation error text, if any, and a general recording of every possible post-save outcome are not expressible without a specified expected message.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact validation error text, if any, and a general recording of every possible post-save outcome are not expressible without a specified expected message.

steps.note: Open the events list to reach the saved draft.
Verify the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab as required by the scenario.
Open the first available saved draft.
Verify that the attachment window is open before submitting empty fields.
Attempt to save with no file selected and no URL entered.
Verify the empty save preserves the attachment window rather than completing an attachment save.
